title: mri_annotation2label
description: Convert an annotation into multiple label files or into a segmentation volume.

lobes.description: Create an annotation based on cortical lobes, saved to <LobesFile>.
lobes.title: Lobes file

lobes_strict.description: Use a stricter lobe definition with precentral added to 'frontal' and postcentral with 'parietal', saved to <LobesFile>.
lobes_strict.title: Lobes strict file

lobes_strict_phcg.description: Use a stricter lobe definition with an additional lobe 'parahippocampalgyrus', saved to <LobesFile>.
lobes_strict_phcg.title: Lobes strict PHCG file

seg.description: Output will be a segmentation volume.
seg.title: Segmentation file

segbase.description: Add base to the annotation number to get segmentation value.
segbase.title: Segmentation base

border.description: Output will be a binary overlay of the parc borders.
border.title: Border file

subjects_dir.description: Specify SUBJECTS_DIR on the command line.
subjects_dir.title: Subjects directory

surface.description: Name of surface <white>. Only affect xyz in label.
surface.title: Surface

stat.description: Surface overlay file (curv or volume format).
stat.title: Stat file
